name: Poulan PLN1514
blurb: Oregon prints one chain under PLN1514: 14″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 49 drive links (S49).
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints Poulan PLN1514 on its own line with chain S49: 14″ bar, 49 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. 49 links is what the guide prints. It is not the 52-link loop on many other 14″ low-profile bars. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon prints S49 directly under Poulan PLN1514: 14″ bar, 49 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 7 Nov 2026. The guide does not print a file size on these rows.
